scope: Read-only diagnostic; no new production acceptance threshold

definition.J: dx/dxi stored as natural rows / physical columns; G=J^{-1} J^{-T}
definition.h: 2/sqrt(gdir), meters; matches native directional tau regularization
definition.Pe: q*|E|*h/(2*kB*T), common to n/p for scalar Einstein ZnO transport
definition.zero_field: E=0 gives Pe=0 and h=2*sqrt(3/trace(G)); retain zero-field points
definition.carrier_perturbation: expm1(eta); signed values and absolute amplitude retained
definition.statistics: all positive quadrature weights, volume weighted, no exclusions or clipping

completeness: One row per element per tensor Gauss point; full vectors and scalar samples retained in NPZ
